messages:
lina_product: Quick sync — need to lock the weighted prioritization for data retention windows and a rollback plan for the enterprise launch. Customers A/B/C have conflicting asks and legal wants firm guarantees.
mmartin: noted. do we have a proposed scoring model? i can wire up a spreadsheet if we agree on weights. :+1:
lina_product: thinking weights: security/risk 40%, customer impact 30%, implementation effort 20%, ops complexity 10%. open to pushback.
ops_jamie: ops complexity should be higher for production impact — at least 20%. retention changes touch archival + search.
eng_raj: implementation effort might be underestimated. BYOK integration + KMS lifecycle across regions is a big chunk. can we split infra effort from API work?
legal_sam: customers want BYOK with retention controls + legal hold. need acceptance criteria we can sign for:
legal_sam: ```
- retention window configurable per-tenant (min/max)
- legal hold overrides with immutable snapshot export
- audit log entries for retention changes (actor + timestamp + reason)
- BYOK handshake documented, key escrow option explained
```
sec_ana: +1 on audit log detail. also require detection for accidental shorter retention rollout. want a "kill-switch" to prevent retroactive deletion until verification. :warning:
lina_product: good call. propose we publish launch gates:
lina_product: 1) BYOK handshake + test key lifecycle in two regions
2) retention config API + audit logs end-to-end
3) legal hold snapshot export working with SLA 48h
4) rollback plan validated in staging with simulated tenants
eng_raj: for #4 i propose automation: a teardown script that replays deletions and restores from snapshot. i'll add a test harness.
ops_jamie: need runbook entries for oncall: how to detect misconfiguration, how to escalate, and the rollback playbook. i'll draft.
mmartin: i'll build the prioritization sheet with the weights we settle on. can we get a list of top 8 customers and their requested windows?
lina_product: i'll DM the list after this. also need to decide on phased rollout: pilot (3 customers) -> broader beta (20) -> GA. pilot must include one high-risk/regulatory tenant.
legal_sam: confirm retention export format (preferred: JSONL + signed manifest). also define evidence retention for audits.
sec_ana: we should add monitoring alerts: retention-policy-change anomaly (weekly baseline) and high-deletion-rate spike.
deploybot: deploy queued: retention-api-v2 (canary) -> staging (1793334500). automated tests scheduled.
eng_raj: timeline: dev (2w) -> int (1w) -> pilot (2w) -> beta (3w). counts as 8w total. any objections?
mmartin: fine if ops and legal sign off in time. i'll prioritize scoring so we can pick pilot tenants.
lina_product: action items:
- mmartin: prioritization sheet + pilot candidate ranking (due EOD Thu)
- eng_raj: test harness + rollback automation (PR by next Tue)
- ops_jamie: runbook + oncall playbook (draft by next Wed)
- legal_sam: export format + acceptance criteria doc (ASAP)
- sec_ana: alert definitions + test cases (this sprint)
- lina_product: coordinate pilot invites and communications

lina_product: if no objections i will lock weights at 40/30/20/10 and start pilot outreach. :eyes:
ops_jamie: one small ask — add a manual freeze control in console for retention toggles. ops needs a human abort path.
lina_product: got it, adding to acceptance criteria.
legal_sam: minor: include clause in customer onboarding about legal hold process and expected export timelines.
eng_raj: FYI — BYOK handshake doc will include HSM/KMS key rotation constraints and how we store key references (we don't persist raw key material).
mmartin: thanks everyone. i'll post the sheet link when ready.
sec_ana: tagging security review in the roadmap ticket once draft is up.
lina_product: perfect. closing this thread — we'll reconvene after the sheet + runbook drafts. :thumbsup:
